svg.title: CCIE Service Provider master lab topology
svg.desc: Validated thirty-node dual-plane service provider topology with eight P routers, eight PE routers, two route reflectors and PCEs, nine customer edges, two clients and one automation workstation. P7, P8, PE7 and PE8 are the expansion nodes.
svg.text: 30 nodes | 18 XRd + 11 IOL + AUTO1 | 47 links | expanded underlay validated 2026-07-30
VPNv4/VPNv6 route reflection · redundant PCE roles
Provider core · IS-IS Level 2 · IPv4/IPv6 · SR-MPLS
Provider edge · dual-homed PEs · VPN service foundation
Customer edge · single/dual-homed CE · L2VPN/L3VPN/EVPN practice
2026 expansion: P7, P8, PE7 and PE8 · links L040-L047
Source of truth: inventory/nodes.csv + inventory/links.csv · generated by tools/render_topology.py
